questions.text: At which OSI layer does IP routing primarily operate?
questions.explanation: IP addressing and routing operate at the network layer (Layer 3).

questions.text: Select ALL transport-layer protocols from this list.
questions.explanation: TCP and UDP are transport protocols. HTTP is application-layer; Ethernet concerns the data-link and physical layers.

questions.text: How many bits are in an IPv4 address? Enter a number.
questions.explanation: IPv4 uses a 32-bit address, commonly displayed as four 8-bit octets.

questions.text: An initially empty FIFO queue receives 4, then 5. What value does the first dequeue operation return?
questions.explanation: FIFO means first in, first out. The first inserted value is 4.

questions.text: Convert the unsigned binary number 1011 to decimal. Enter a number.
